abstract_or_description: We present VerSe, a benchmark of 374 multi-detector CT scans with vertebrae labels from C1 to L6. Segmentation masks were drawn by experts and the challenge data can be downloaded from OSF.
title: VerSe: A Vertebrae labelling and segmentation benchmark for multi-detector CT images
